assessments.reason: Investigates electrical stimulation combined with stretching exercises and orthoses for treating plantar fasciitis; it does not evaluate the effect of stretching upon waking on systemic circulation.
Examines the effect of yoga on arterial stiffness in elderly subjects with increased pulse pressure; it does not specifically examine stretching upon waking or general circulation.

Studies sleep disturbances during simulated space flight and only mentions a subjective desire to stretch among psychosomatic feelings; it does not evaluate stretching as an intervention to improve circulation.

Provides a general narrative overview of physical exercise, describing flexibility stretching and cardiovascular benefits, but does not test the specific effect of stretching immediately after waking on circulation.
Examines N-terminal pro-brain natriuretic peptide and myocardial stretch in obstructive sleep apnea syndrome; it uses 'stretch' in a cellular/cardiac context rather than physical stretching exercise.
Investigates respiratory sinus arrhythmia and thoracic stretch receptors rather than bodily stretching exercises.
Includes passive stretching as a control intervention and evaluates hemodynamics and vascular function across morning and evening sessions, though it does not evaluate acute stretching upon waking.
Investigates rat cerebral vascular responses and vessel stretch during sleep and sleep deprivation, not physical body stretching.
Discusses stretch of ventricular myocytes in congestive heart failure patients, which is unrelated to physical stretching.
Uses stretching merely as a control condition to evaluate memory performance and physiological arousal following morning exercise or caffeine, without assessing circulatory outcomes.
Introduces physical inactivity in female college students and mentions yoga, but provides no data or evaluation of post-waking stretching on circulation.
Reviews pathophysiological mechanisms of nocturia and refers to stretching of heart chambers due to venous return, not bodily stretching exercise.
Focuses on joint pain, function, and morning stiffness in osteoarthritis, without examining stretching to boost circulation after waking.

claims.missing_evidence: Controlled clinical trials or physiological studies directly measuring the acute or sustained effects of whole-body stretching immediately after waking on blood flow, vascular conductance, or systemic circulation.
